title: Exponential density conjecture for matroids excluding an induced $I_t$-restriction
statement:
Let $t\geq 2$ and $r\geq t$ be integers. A matroid $M=(E,G)$ is **full-rank** when $G=\operatorname{cl}(E)$; it is $r$-dimensional when $\dim(G)=r$. Let $I_t$ denote the $t$-dimensional matroid being excluded, and let $s$ be the remainder of $r$ on division by $t-1$. A **flat** is a projective subgeometry of $G$.

**Exponential density conjecture.** If $M=(E,G)$ is a full-rank, $r$-dimensional matroid with no induced $I_t$-restriction, then

$$
|E|\geq s2^{\left\lceil r/(t-1)\right\rceil}+(t-1-s)2^{\left\lfloor r/(t-1)\right\rfloor}-(t-1).
$$

Equality holds precisely when $E$ is the disjoint union of flats $F_1,\dotsc,F_{t-1}$ whose dimensions sum to $r$, with $|\dim(F_i)-\dim(F_j)|\leq 1$ for all $i,j$.

This generalises the proved density theorem for claw-free matroids. The paper says that even the case $t=3$ is difficult and that the conjecture is not known in the supplied text.
source_name: Peter Nelson and Kazuhiro Nomoto, “The structure of claw-free binary matroids”, arXiv:1807.11543 (2018).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.11543

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of July 2018).
